This creature is an ambush predator targeting the humanoids populating an otherwise peaceful town. notes.effect:
As you can probably imagine, this enemy's stealth mechanic is easily abuse-able, especially since, from its second consecutive turn onwards spent in hiding, it heals for free. It doesn't heal as much in one turn as, say, the default Lick Wounds spell would, but having basically no risk of being interrupted until it either stops on purpose or a four-clock is filled makes up for that somewhat. Ideally, I wouldn't advise it pulling this cheap trick unless it's very much at risk of dying in a turn or two, when thematically it would actually act on self preservation instinct.
In the case of only hiding for the one turn, I'd say have it do that every other round or so, at the start of the round, and give the players a chance to strategize on who's turn should be spent doing something not related to damage.
